title: Automated data ingestion and processing
summary: System cognizant.ingestion: original narrative, linked evidence and 1 accomplishment(s).
body:
## Automated data ingestion and processing

- Built automated data-ingestion pipelines in Python and Apache Spark.
- Processed 50M+ rows per day.
- Used SQL and PySpark-style distributed processing patterns.
- Fed downstream KPI and analytics workflows.

Output and impact:

- Maintained production-scale ingestion at 50M+ rows per day.
- Established the data movement and transformation foundation used by downstream analytics.
